headline: UOB Q3 Net Profit Jumps 182% on Lower Provisions
summary: United Overseas Bank posted a third-quarter net profit of $1.25 billion, an 182% surge compared to the previous year, as the bank set aside fewer provisions for bad loans.
why: United Overseas Bank is one of Southeast Asia's premier financial institutions, providing extensive commercial and corporate banking services.

impacts.name: United Overseas Bank
impacts.why: A sharp decline in loan loss provisions directly expands net earnings and profitability metrics.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reduced credit-cost allowances significantly lifted net income compared to prior periods, easing asset quality concerns.
